q: Are you passionate about e-commerce technology, system optimization, and finding smarter ways to improve online shopping platforms?

We’re looking for an E-Commerce System Administrator who understands that a successful online shopping experience goes beyond what customers see on the website. It's about managing the systems behind it, optimizing backend functionalities, ensuring seamless integrations, and keeping every digital touchpoint running smoothly.
What You Bring to the Table
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience in e-commerce systems administration or website platform management.
Hands-on experience with Magento and Shopify , including backend administration and configuration.
Good understanding of CMS, PIM, product management, and e-commerce functionalities.
Experience with system integrations, APIs, and technical troubleshooting.
Knowledge of HTML, CSS, and basic web development concepts.
Experience with UAT, system testing, bug tracking, and platform enhancements.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.
Fluent in English; Arabic is a plus.
Join a growing e-commerce business where technology meets retail. Take ownership of key digital platforms, work on impactful system enhancements, and help shape a seamless online shopping experience.
If you have the technical expertise and e-commerce platform experience we're looking for, we'd love to hear from you.
r: Manage E-Commerce Platforms: Administer and maintain Magento and Shopify platforms, including backend configurations, system settings, product management, categories, and navigation.
Keep the Platform Running: Monitor website functionality, troubleshoot technical issues, and ensure smooth day-to-day e-commerce operations.
Make Campaigns Happen: Configure promotions, discounts, vouchers, banners, and campaign setups within the platforms.
Optimize System Functionality: Manage platform enhancements, backend updates, integrations, and new feature implementations.
Test Before You Launch: Conduct UAT, troubleshoot bugs, validate system changes, and coordinate with developers to ensure successful deployments.
Connect Systems & Teams: Work closely with developers, IT, marketing, and merchandising teams to resolve issues and improve platform performance.
